title: tephrosia purpurea var. piscatoria
intro: Tephrosia purpurea var. piscatoria, commonly known as Piscatoria, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, inflammation, and various other ailments. The health benefits of Piscatoria are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal efficacy.
